newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as U.S. premium stays high.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as U.S. premium stays high.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower as the U.S. premium remains high relative to overseas values, traders said.
"U.S. futures are still struggling with a huge premium," a trader said.
Traders said the benchmark Thai cash price is actually down to $325.00 per tonne rather than the published $335.00 and the U.S. cash market remains overpriced at $425.00 per ton.
"The political situation in the Gulf does not promote business either," the trader said.
Rice closed six to 13 cents per cwt lower, with Novembber down 7-1/2 at $9.75-1/2 per cwt.
